items.title: Document Host Overflow architecture and boundaries
items.context: Add a host-neutral architecture document for Lattice Host Overflow / Host Conduit. It must define Lattice as authority, hosts as executors, manual mode first, supervised dispatch as conservative projection, and explicit non-goals such as no hidden-context sharing or auto-trust.
items.userSees: 用户能在文档中看到 Codex agent 不够时如何安全使用 Claude Code overflow，以及哪些情况不能 overflow。

happy.desc: Docs explain Lattice Host Overflow as host-neutral authority: Lattice owns story/scope/receipt/gate, Codex/Claude Code/Gemini are execution hosts.

edge.desc: Docs explicitly say manual handoff comes before supervised dispatch and Claude Code unavailable is a diagnostic degradation, not a workflow blocker.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not claim Lattice is a new agent runtime, Mac App requirement, productionDone source, or automatic trust/merge mechanism for Claude Code output.

items.title: Add host capability model for overflow readiness
items.context: Implement a CLI-visible capability report for claude-code/codex/local-runner style hosts, including availability, edit/shell/worktree/review/receipt capabilities, limits, and nextAction when unavailable.
items.userSees: 用户运行 lattice host_status 或 capability command 时能看到 claude-code 是否可作为 overflow host 以及缺失时的 nextAction。

happy.desc: lattice host_status --host=claude-code --format=json reports overflow readiness, capabilities, limits, availability, and nextAction.

edge.desc: Unknown or unavailable host returns diagnostic unavailable/warn with nextAction and does not block local story workflow.

adversarial.desc: Capability/status output keeps productionDone=false and receiptVerified=false; it never treats host availability as authority evidence.

items.title: Create bounded handoff pack schema and CLI
items.context: Add handoff pack creation/inspection for host overflow tasks with storyId, role, host, objective, baseSha, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, requiredCommands, successCriteria, authority boundary, and pack hash.
items.userSees: 用户能生成可复制给 Claude Code 的 handoff pack，pack 明确写了 allowed paths、commands、success criteria 和不能直接改 story JSON。

happy.desc: lattice handoff_create can create a Claude Code overflow pack with role, objective, baseSha, packId, packHash, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, requiredCommands, successCriteria, and authority boundary.

edge.desc: Existing handoff_create/inspect/accept/resume compatibility remains intact for old handoff-pack-v0 consumers.

adversarial.desc: Handoff pack instructions forbid direct story JSON edits, auto-merge, auto-trust, evidence submission, receipt verification, and productionDone claims.

items.title: Add manual receipt submit and gate-consumable evidence
items.context: Implement a receipt submit/read path for completed external host handoffs. Receipt must reference packId/hash/base/head, commands, changedFiles, verdict, limitations, and scope status. session_brief or inspect output should surface active/completed handoff state.
items.userSees: Claude Code 完成任务后可以通过 lattice 提交 receipt，Codex 主线程能看到 receipt 是否 pass、stale 或越界。

happy.desc: lattice handoff_receipt_submit accepts a completed external-host receipt referencing packId/hash/base/head, commands, changedFiles, verdict, and limitations, then returns accepted-local status.

edge.desc: Receipt submit reports stale or scope warning/failure when head/base/hash or changedFiles do not match the pack constraints.

adversarial.desc: Receipt submit remains local diagnostic evidence with authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, and cannot satisfy server authority by itself.

items.title: Add overflow worktree isolation guidance
items.context: Provide safe worktree guidance and creation metadata for overflow tasks. Each external-host task should have its own branch/worktree, baseSha, packId, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, and merge/cleanup guidance. Do not include unavailable-host reporting here; host availability belongs to CHK-002.
items.userSees: 用户能看到每个 overflow task 应在独立 worktree 执行，并看到 worktree path、branch、baseSha、packId、allowedPaths 与 cleanup/merge guidance。

happy.desc: lattice handoff_worktree_create or equivalent projection returns worktree path, branch, baseSha, packId, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, and cleanup/merge guidance for an overflow task.

edge.desc: Worktree isolation guidance refuses or warns when pack constraints are missing and does not modify external host results.

adversarial.desc: Worktree projection does not auto-merge, does not delete unaccepted work, and keeps external host edits outside the main Codex worktree until reviewed.

items.title: Cover Host Overflow with tests and delivery transcript
items.context: Add smoke tests for capability report, handoff pack creation/inspection, receipt submit, stale/hash/scope behavior, and supervised dispatch unavailable behavior. Record a user-facing transcript showing manual Claude Code overflow flow without requiring Mac App.
items.userSees: 用户看到测试证明：pack 可生成、receipt 可提交、越界/陈旧可识别、Claude Code 不可用时不阻塞主流程。

items.title: Add conservative supervised dispatch projection
items.context: Add a host_dispatch-style projection for overflow tasks. It may detect whether Claude Code is unavailable and return unavailable/warn with nextAction, and when available it records planned dispatch metadata only. It must not auto-trust results, auto-merge diffs, submit authority evidence, or claim productionDone.
items.userSees: 用户运行 supervised dispatch projection 时看到 planned/unavailable 状态、nextAction、authorityChanged=false、productionDone=false；不可用时流程不崩溃。
